title: Install Rovunet
private: An existing installation in this folder will be upgraded. Your profiles are preserved.
preview: Visual installer preview. This version does not install the app.
review: Private preview. Installation and upgrades use the selected folder.
existing: Choose an existing installation or an empty folder.
failed: Installation did not complete. Check the folder and available disk space.
unknownFolder: This folder contains files but is not a recognized Rovunet installation. Choose an existing installation or an empty folder.
rollbackFailed: Installation and recovery could not finish. The .Rovunet-backup folder beside the installation has been retained.
uacCancelled: Administrator approval was cancelled. Retry or choose a folder in your account.
invalidPath: Choose a regular Rovunet subfolder, rather than a drive root or system directory.
successHint: Rovunet is ready. Select Finish to close the installer.
admin: Installing in Program Files requires administrator approval in the Windows prompt.
appRunning: Rovunet is open or an installation file is in use. Choose Exit from its menu, then retry.
launchUser: After closing this elevated installer, open Rovunet from your regular account.
